status: SPECIFIED — values transcribed from D-21 (operator-decided); formal precommitment happens when the hidden set is sealed, before SH#2 (D-21 §31). Any change needs a new version, rationale, evidence and a new precommitment before a new independent run (D-21 §38).
notice: D-21 PERFORMANCE THRESHOLDS ARE WONDERPAGES ENTERPRISE LOCAL RC1 PRODUCT-ACCEPTANCE POLICY, NOT UNIVERSAL EMPIRICAL CONSTANTS.
appliesTo: the new independent hidden acceptance set (D-20) on the frozen evaluator; never retroactively to historical reports

representation.autoAcceptableNote: PASS_WITH_ADVISORY is auto-acceptable only when the advisory does not carry a required review; an expected REVIEW_REQUIRED returned as PASS_WITH_ADVISORY whose advisory does not preserve the mandatory review is a P1 escape (D-21 §5).
representation.binaryLegacy: descriptive/historical only; acceptance never collapses states into positive/negative

P0.name: integrity / execution validity
P0.onFailure: INVALID_RUN — not acceptable as evidence; neither product PASS nor FAIL

P1.name: critical auto-accept escape
P1.definition: expected state not auto-acceptable (BLOCKED_BY_POLICY, REPAIR_REQUIRED, REVIEW_REQUIRED, ASSESSMENT_INVALID, ASSESSMENT_VALIDATION_REQUIRED) and the final system state auto-acceptable

bound.method: exact binomial, one-sided upper bound (Clopper-Pearson one-sided)

P1.denominator: only cases whose adjudicated ground truth creates a P1 opportunity; no PASS cases, no stimuli without the relevant jurisdiction
P1.poolingRule: the pooled P1 claim never substitutes D-19 structural coverage per jurisdiction

P2.name: non-waivable → waivable downgrade
P2.definition: expected confirmed non-waivable state (BLOCKED_BY_POLICY, REPAIR_REQUIRED) returned as an operator-waivable state (REVIEW_REQUIRED)
P2.uncertainty: reported (numerator, denominator, one-sided exact 95% upper bound); no population-rate claim in RC1

P3.name: false escalation on auto-acceptable cases
P3.definition: expected auto-acceptable state (PASS; PASS_WITH_ADVISORY without required review) returned as a non-auto-acceptable state
P3.perCellRule: every required D-19 cell that contains auto-acceptable cases shows at least one correct auto-accept
P3.uncertainty: two-sided exact (Clopper-Pearson) 95% interval reported; sample acceptance rule, not a population-rate guarantee

P4.name: consequence accuracy
P4.rule: reported per state (exact agreement, confusion matrix, per kind, per cell, exact error list); no additional thresholds; never compensates P1/P2

P5.name: assessment validation
P5.rule: INVALID / UNVERIFIED treated as sufficient for auto-publication counts as P1; reported: assessment-validation accuracy, invalid-assessment detection, valid-assessment false rejection, UNVERIFIED frequency, downstream consequence

P6.name: finding detection
P6.rule: recall, precision, FN, FP per D-19 dimension, reported; a missed finding producing P1/P2 fails through P1/P2; no separate numeric threshold in RC1

P7.name: severity accuracy
P7.rule: reported separately from finding presence; a non-waivable → waivable downgrade fails through P2

P8.name: policy-consequence accuracy
P8.rule: state of the authoritative jurisdiction, per layer; another layer (e.g. T07) may not repair a wrong gate verdict

P9.name: publishing-decision accuracy
P9.rule: correct auto-accept / advisory / review / repair / block; false auto-accept; false escalation; authority downgrade — reported, main product layer, does not replace upstream metrics

d19.structuralMinimum: every required cell non-zero in calibration (adjudicated) and in independent validation (independently adjudicable)

determinism.deterministicComponents: 100% identical outputs for identical input + version + configuration
determinism.modelComponents: stability contract required before entering the acceptance pipeline (docs/enterprise/rc1/PRE-HARDENING-SPEC.md [S-STABILITY]); without it a non-deterministic component cannot alone ground a critical auto-PASS

failClosed: fail-closed decisions are counted and reported separately from correct semantic decisions; UNKNOWN / INVALID / UNVERIFIED reaching auto-accept without an explicit rule is a P1 failure

statisticalConvention.acceptance: one-sided exact 95% upper bound (Clopper-Pearson one-sided): for x = 0 the bound is 1 − 0.05^(1/n)
statisticalConvention.descriptive: two-sided Clopper-Pearson 95% interval may be reported, never mixed with the acceptance convention

antiGaming: always-REVIEW fails P2 (BLOCKED_BY_POLICY → REVIEW_REQUIRED) and P3
no averaging between P1/P2 and P3
noPostHocRelaxation: after the blind run: no 5% → 10%, no 'one error is acceptable', no removal of a missed case unless independent adjudication shows invalid ground truth under the precommitted protocol ([S-INVALID-GT]); label correction is never a passing mechanism
canonicalization: canonicalSha256 = SHA-256 (hex) of the canonical JSON (object keys sorted, arrays in order, no whitespace, UTF-8) of this object without the field canonicalSha256; checked by node brain/tools/rc1.mjs check
